description: Nord-Ostsee Kanal: Schiffstrajektorien 2023 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft zur Förderung der angewandten Forschung e. V.. The data includes all ship trajectories in the area of the North Sea-Baltic Canal in the period 15.1.2023 – 15.2.2023. Coverage: Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft zur Förderung der angewandten Forschung e. V.. The portal shows the English title as "North-Baltic Canal: Ship trajectories 2023" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft zur Förderung der angewandten Forschung e. V.. The listing shows 2023-12-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
